access_prohibition.rule: Neither raw 2024/2025 tables nor model performance files opened by this implementation or tests. Loader is restricted to explicit 2017-2023 paths. Model fit/score entry points reject seasons outside 2018-2023. No confirmation CLI. No goals/SOG confirmation performance parsed.

A0.model: PoissonRegressor on locked direct_count features and all candidate rows, then fixed-mean NB2 dispersion MLE; full NB2 PMF; no tree models
A0.name: DIRECT COUNT BASELINE

A1.availability: Training-only LogisticRegression on locked availability columns; C=1, l2 lbfgs max_iter=2000; a one-class training set uses its constant rate. Prediction never conditions on actual played label.
A1.hyperprior: Beta-binomial marginal MLE on per-(stable player_id, prior position F/D/U) aggregated TRAINING played assists given aggregate non-shootout team goals. 2 parameters per class; class with <30 positive-exposure players uses pooled hyperprior. L-BFGS-B log(a),log(b) bounds log(.05)..log(5000); start pooled mean clipped [.0001,.9999] with concentration 50; max_iter=1000, ftol=1e-10, gtol=1e-6; failed convergence invalidates architecture, boundary hits reported.
A1.name: HIERARCHICAL SCORING-OPPORTUNITY COMPOUND
A1.pmf: (1-p_active)*delta0 + p_active*sum_g NB2_team_goals(g)*BetaBinomial(assist_count;g,q*(a+b),(1-q)*(a+b)). Exact analytic compound, no evaluation simulation.
A1.posterior: a=a_position+ASSISTS_SUM_CUM; b=b_position+TEAM_GOALS_EXPOSURE_CUM-ASSISTS_SUM_CUM. Exposure sums refer only to legal all-team appearances, including 2017. No target game contribution.
A1.role_adjustment: Training-only binomial logit regression on played rows with positive team goals: posterior mean logit as offset; intercept + locked involvement_role features and their missing indicators; l2 .001 on coefficients, intercept unpenalized. Loss divided by training row count; L-BFGS-B starting zeros, max_iter1000 ftol1e-10 gtol1e-6. Adjusted posterior mean q=expit(offset+Xb), concentration a+b unchanged. Zero exposure rows omitted from this likelihood only, not candidate population.

A2.allocation: Training residual share rho=sum(outside-candidate assist labels)/sum(total team assist labels), fixed for each fold. Within each team-game, w_i=p_active_i*q_i from A1 legal prior state; candidate probability pi_i=(1-rho)*w_i/sum(w). Remaining rho is outside-candidate bucket. Zero total weight sends all credits outside. Availability is a soft expected involvement weight, not a sampled target lineup.
A2.coherence: Draw total credits T from fitted NB2, allocate multinomial(T, candidate probabilities plus outside bucket). On EVERY draw sum(candidate assists)+outside=T, hence sum(candidate assists)<=T.
A2.credit_total: NB2 regression on TOTAL S0 team assists using locked env columns, once per team-game. This is an aggregate-credit component, not a certified per-goal joint generator; no claim of independent per-goal multiplicity, linemates, or one-assist-per-player-per-goal.
A2.data_feasibility: S0 supports aggregate team assist-credit labels without events. Validate complete team joins and candidate/outside credit partition before ANY performance. If missing/misaligned, status BLOCKED_BY_DATA before performance; never substitute PBP attempts, odds, or invented event credits.
A2.name: CONSERVATION-AWARE TEAM ASSIST ALLOCATION
A2.pmf: NB2 total credits thinned by multinomial assignment: candidate marginal NB2 mean=credit_mean*pi_i with identical credit dispersion. Analytic infinite-support distribution, evaluated to registered tail tolerance.

bootstrap.CI: one-sided95 upper + two-sided2.5/97.5 percentiles; report all pairwise comparisons
bootstrap.method: Same goals/SOG 2 consecutive Monday-based calendar-week moving blocks, GAME-level per-game candidate CRPS delta; pooled D1-D4; valid blocks only consecutive observed weeks; no row bootstrap

commit_order: data/component/model/evaluation code + tests; NO computed development results
D1-D4 development results + selection/frozen failures; STOP

components.team_goal_environment: NB2 total team non-shootout goal count (T0 final score minus shootout winner bonus, includes rare goalie goals), conditional on prior-only env features. Targets and inputs are separate. Regression fit one row per candidate-covered team-game, not repeated per skater. Own GF / opponent GA last <=5 legal team games shrunk with 5 pseudo-games to TRAINING team-goal mean. A2 separately uses identical env regression on total S0 team assist credits. These are uncertified upstream components, not certified team-goal heads.
components.teammate_scoring_opportunity: Sum over EXACT pregame candidates of (plays10+5*training_position_play_rate)/(den10+5) times (prior all-team cumulative goals+5*training_position_goals_per_appearance)/(prior all-team appearances+5). Team component uses full sum; A0 uses leave-self-out sum. Membership, plays and role stay current-team; skill may cross teams. No future roster or teammate label is used.

confirmation_procedure.future_2024: Only separate authorized task after committed development selection, freeze chosen architecture and strongest remaining valid development comparator; refit2018-2023 and score2024 once
confirmation_procedure.future_2025: Only if2024 passes and committed; refit2018-2024; same chosen/comparator; score2025 once
confirmation_procedure.guards: CRPS/NLL selected<=comparator*1.005; PITKS and PIT80/90 absolute error not worse>.02; abs relative bias<=.05; ECE>=1<=.02; zero calibration gap<=.01; eligible slice CRPS not worse>10%
confirmation_procedure.status_note: Neither confirmation is claimed pristine; source audits previously exposed descriptions; no assists-model performance accessed here; failed confirmation means ASSISTS_HISTORICAL_CHAMPION_NOT_ESTABLISHED, no rescue.
confirmation_procedure.this_task: PROHIBITED; STOP after development commit. No 2024/2025 scoring code path.

cutoff.historical: T90: cutoff=start-90 minutes; usable source_start+210 minutes <= cutoff, source_game_id != target_game_id
cutoff.history: All-team legal prior player scoring skill follows stable player_id. Current role, PP/TOI and participation use CURRENT-TEAM history only. Shared contract unchanged.

feature_contract.preprocessing: Frozen shared Preprocessor: training-only continuous median imputation plus missing indicator for every continuous feature; standardization on training only; rest capped 240h; no feature search

fitting.NB2: fixed-mean bounded MLE log(alpha) in log(1e-6)..log(20); minimize_scalar bounded xatol1e-9; convergence checked
fitting.numerics: Full PMFs: support starts 0..40, grows by doubling until every survival <1e-10, ceiling200; compound inherits team support; no renormalization hiding missing mass; row sums tolerance1e-9; diagnostic clipping q only to [1e-9,1-1e-9] for numerical beta evaluation; invalid distribution or nonconvergence freezes architecture as FIT_OR_DISTRIBUTION_FAILED

locked_dependencies.SOG: B2_HISTORICAL_CHAMPION_RETAINED; never fit or changed here

metrics.primary: macro-game discrete CRPS (mean of within-game mean row CRPS); architecture rank by equal-weight mean of D1-D4
secondary: central interval coverage50/80/90 with attainable discrete mass
Brier and ECE10 equal-count bins for P(assists>=1) and P(assists>=2)
metrics.slice_reporting: all secondary metrics and row/macro-game CRPS; promotion guards use pooled row CRPS to match frozen goals/SOG doctrine; eligible>=500 validation rows

slices.high_role: current-team prior TOI_MEAN_CT_APP3 >=1080 seconds (18min), regardless of position
slices.low_role: current-team prior TOI_MEAN_CT_APP3 <1080 or missing; no outcome-based threshold

population.exact: Frozen Phase 1A builder, target seasons 2018-2023 only; same (game_id,team_id,player_id), order and shared features; last <=10 legal current-team games establish membership
population.nonparticipants: Retained with assists=0. No insertion of unseen target participants; outside-candidate assist credits are labels only for fitting a training-only residual bucket

protected_files: Every pre-existing file at research_base (git blob identity guard); ONLY new nhl_assists_a1_*.py, tests/test_nhl_assists_a1.py, and phase_assists_a1*/PHASE_ASSISTS_A1_README artifacts may be added. No changes to SOG/goals/attempt/shared contract/collector/production/registry.

selection.no_rescue: No hyperparameter/feature/threshold/architecture changes after development performance. Rejected/invalid architectures FROZEN_REJECTED. Winner is DEVELOPMENT_SELECTED_AWAITING_CONFIRMATION only, never historical champion.
selection.procedure: Sequential complexity order against CURRENT incumbent; choose simpler unless ALL guards pass; absence/invalid A0 means honest development failure, never rescue

promotion.bootstrap: pooled game delta one-sided95 upper<0 (BOTH practical gain AND statistical support required)
promotion.calibration: mean-fold PIT80/90 absolute coverage error degradation<=.02
promotion.fold_consistency: improvement in at least3 of4 validation folds
promotion.slice_guard: no eligible pooled F/D, early/established, high/low role slice >5% worse in row CRPS

target: Frozen S0 official skater assist COUNT (nonnegative integer), joined (game_id,player_id), target-game labels attached only after features complete. points=goals+assists must hold; no alteration of frozen labels.
